started: Loresoft YouTube Clipster started. Copy a YouTube link to start a download.
only_one_instance: The program is already running. Only one instance is allowed.
only_one_instance_pid: The program is already running (PID {pid}). Only one instance is allowed.
phone_intro: Send YouTube links from your phone, tablet or another computer; this PC downloads them. Nothing has to be installed - the device just opens a page this program serves.
phone_enable_hint: While this is off, no other device can reach this PC.
phone_reach_network: Every device on my network (needed to control it from elsewhere)
phone_status_failed: Could not listen on this port - is it already in use?
phone_status_waiting: Listening. Waiting for a device to connect...
phone_status_contact: A device reached this PC (last contact {when}).
phone_token_new_warning:
A new token disconnects every device that is paired right now. They have to connect again.

Generate a new token?
phone_code_hint: Point a phone's camera at the code, or copy the address to any other device.
phone_code_off: Switch it on to get a code.
phone_code_missing: The optional 'qrcode' package is missing - use the address below.
phone_step_scan: 1. Scan the code, or open the address on any device. The token is remembered, so this is only needed once.
phone_step_install: 2. Add it to the home screen - Android (Chrome): menu, Add to home screen. iPhone (Safari): share button, Add to Home Screen.
phone_step_share: 3. Then share instead of copy: in the YouTube app tap Share and pick Clipster. On the iPhone use a Shortcut (see the README).
android_intro: Puts this program onto a phone plugged in over USB, so the phone downloads by itself. The phone needs Termux (from F-Droid) — the last step runs there, because Android does not let this computer write into another app's storage.
android_adb_missing: adb is not installed — without it no phone can be reached.
android_adb_windows: Install the Android SDK platform tools and put adb on the PATH.
android_adb_manual: Install the Android platform tools for your system.
android_adb_declined: Not installed — adb is still missing.
android_device_none: No phone found. Plug it in with a cable that carries data.
android_device_unauthorised: The phone is asking whether to allow USB debugging — tap “Allow” on its screen.
android_device_offline: The phone answers but is not ready. Unplug it and plug it in again.
android_device_help: On the phone: Settings → About phone → tap “Build number” seven times, then Settings → System → Developer options → USB debugging.
android_finish_ready: Now run the line below in Termux on the phone — once.
android_run_started: The command is running in Termux on the phone. Watch it there — it asks you to accept the terms of use once (tap “y”) and Android will ask for storage permission.
android_run_failed: The command could not be typed. Copy it and run it in Termux by hand.
android_run_failed_termux_missing: Termux could not be started. Is it installed (F-Droid)?
android_run_failed_termux_not_open: Termux did not come to the front, so nothing was typed — a command must never land in another app. Open Termux on the phone and press this again.
android_run_failed_typing_failed: The phone did not accept the keystrokes. Copy the command and run it in Termux by hand.
android_run_failed_untypeable: This command cannot be typed safely. Copy it and run it in Termux by hand.
android_copied: Copied. Paste it into Termux on the phone.
android_termux_opened: Termux was brought to the front on the phone.
android_termux_failed: Termux could not be started — open it by hand.
discover_status_idle: Click Find similar songs to start your streaming queue.
discover_empty: No songs in the queue yet. Download a few tracks, then click Find similar songs.
discover_no_seeds: No seed songs found. Download tracks with Clipster, like songs in Streaming, or add media files to your Downloads / Music folders.
discover_blocked: YouTube blocked Streaming (sign-in / bot check). In Settings → YouTube cookies, acknowledge the risk and set a browser or cookies.txt (optional, own account), then try again.
discover_blocked_with_cookies: YouTube still blocked Streaming (bot check) even though cookies were sent. Refresh your YouTube login or export fresh cookies under Settings → YouTube cookies.
discover_blocked_partial: YouTube started blocking further requests; showing partial results.
discover_suffix_relaxed: No titles contained “{suffix}”, so matching was relaxed.
discover_filtered_empty: {count} YouTube hits found, but none contained “{suffix}”. Uncheck the ending filter or change the ending.
discover_extend_empty: No additional related songs found right now.
discover_playback_failed: The stream could not be started.
discover_playback_bot: The stream could not start — YouTube asked for sign-in / bot check. In Settings → YouTube cookies, acknowledge the risk and set a browser or cookies.txt (optional, own account).
discover_playback_bot_with_cookies: The stream could not start — cookies were sent but YouTube still blocked (bot check). Refresh login or export fresh cookies under Settings → YouTube cookies.
discover_require_suffix: Only show titles that contain the ending
settings_discover_require_suffix: Only keep Streaming results with that ending in the title
settings_cookies_hint: Optional, at your own risk — own YouTube account only. May conflict with YouTube’s terms; does not authorize infringement. If YouTube asks you to sign in / confirm you are not a bot: tick the risk box below, choose a logged-in browser or cookies.txt, then Save. Cookie contents are never stored in the log.
settings_cookies_risk_ack: I understand that using cookies is at my own risk and may violate third-party terms.
history_empty: No downloads yet. Copy a YouTube link and the download starts by itself.
history_delete_failed: The file could not be deleted: {details}
history_clear_confirm: Remove all entries from the list? The downloaded files are kept.
tray_tooltip: YouTube Clipster - waiting for a link
tray_minimized: YouTube Clipster keeps running in the system tray. Use the tray icon to quit it.
tray_minimized_click: YouTube Clipster keeps running in the system tray. Click the tray icon to open this window again.
link_received: YouTube link received, preparing the process...
nav_already: This video has already been downloaded.
error_bot_detected: YouTube blocked this request (sign-in / bot check). In Settings → YouTube cookies, acknowledge the risk and set a browser or cookies.txt (optional, own account), then try again.
error_bot_with_cookies: YouTube still blocked this request (bot check) even though cookies were sent. Refresh your YouTube login or export fresh cookies under Settings → YouTube cookies, then try again.
error_unavailable: This video is not available (private, deleted or region locked).
error_metadata:
The video information could not be loaded.

about_text: Downloads YouTube videos or audio automatically as soon as a YouTube link is copied to the clipboard. One Python code base for Linux, Windows and macOS.
about_license: GPLv3 - the author's name (Joachim Ruf, Loresoft.de) must be credited upon publication and modification.
about_terms_note: On first launch you must accept the terms of use. Streaming requires an additional confirmation the first time you use it.
